Class Statue

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.holograms.api.Statue
public final class Statue extends Object
A life-size figure of a player, in the look they had when last seen (see Skins), turning to face the nearest player. Nothing shows for a player whose look is not known yet. Made with Holograms.statue(String, String, Vector3d, UUID).
